items.title: The biggest questions behind the $100 billion Venezuelan oil bet by the US
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Washington Correspondent Ben Werschkul joins Market Domination host Josh Lipton to report on the US-Venezuela oil deal that will require $100 billion in capital investments and whether the partner company, North American Blue Energy Partners, is ready to ramp up its oil production.

items.title: Who Really Got Rights to Venezuela’s 65 Billion Barrels Of Oil Prize?
items.summary: Washington just handed a 100-year lease on tens of billions of barrels of Venezuelan oil to a private company nobody has heard of, while Chevron quietly hit a 52-week high on a completely separate deal. The two stories are getting conflated in ways that could cost investors.

items.title: 3 of Wall Street’s Safest High-Yield Dividend Stocks With Over 25-Year Increase Streaks
items.summary: Not all Dividend Aristocrats are created equal, and three companies spanning payroll processing, supplemental insurance, and integrated energy have quietly stacked 25-plus years of annual raises through completely different cash engines.

items.title: RBC backs gold as Hormuz shipping risks rattle markets
items.summary: Gold faced a reality check from RBC Capital Markets on Thursday, as the Canadian bank flagged near-term consumer headwinds but stopped well short of a bearish call. RBC Capital Markets maintained its constructive outlook on gold, even as elevated United States 10-year Treasury yields raised...

items.title: Chevron gets Street-High PT at Piper Sandler on booming oil prices
items.summary: Investing.com -- Piper Sandler has lifted its Chevron price target to a Street-high $243 from $207, part of a broader round of estimate increases across its integrated oil and refiner coverage driven by stronger crude and refining margins.

items.title: Chevron Commits $7 Billion to Venezuela to Double Production to 600,000 Barrels a Day
items.summary: Chevron just placed a multi-billion dollar bet on Venezuelan oil within days of a historic U.S. reserve deal, moving far faster than energy insiders predicted and becoming the first major to put real money behind a country whose oil sector has been closed to Western firms for 15 years.

items.title: BlackRock Says $2.1 Trillion Gulf Spending Boom Could Reshape Global Capital Flows
items.summary: BlackRock's top strategist says Gulf sovereign wealth funds are rerouting trillions away from global markets, and the ripple effects on Treasuries, equities, and AI infrastructure could be bigger than most investors expect.

items.title: Chevron to invest more than $7bn in Venezuela oil ventures
items.summary: Chevron has received more acreage in the Orinoco Belt, extending its existing operations in the region.
